name: Tailkits

sources.title: Submit your product — Free tier (14+ day wait, no dedicated page) via Tally form; Booster $19-29 (2-day publish, dedicated page, HOT badge); Partner $199-279; Sponsored review $499; strict Tailwind-only FAQ

conditions: Free listing queue is '14+ business days' for review and free listings get NO dedicated page
Manual quality review applies to every tier — clean code, professional design/UX, full responsiveness required
requirements: Tailwind CSS products ONLY — UI kits, templates (Astro/Next.js/React/Vue), Tailwind utilities; Bootstrap/other frameworks rejected outright
Working public live demo URL required — 'coming soon' pages or broken links = immediate rejection
Unique brand name required — keyword-stuffed names like 'Free Tailwind Dashboard' rejected
Design-only assets (Figma/Sketch) rejected unless shipped with production-ready Tailwind code
Free submission is via Tally form (https://tally.so/r/wAlEZD)
preparation: Live demo URL of the Tailwind product
Product details for the Tally form; screenshots for listing
Decide tier: Free (14+ day review, no dedicated page) vs Booster $19-29 vs Partner $199-279 vs Sponsored review $499
workflow: Free route: click 'Submit product' under Free → fills Tally form wAlEZD
Wait up to 14+ business days for manual review
If rejected from a paid tier, full refund is promised
Updates to an existing listing go through their support team
watchFor: Free tier is deliberately thin — 14+ day wait and no dedicated page means limited SEO value
Non-Tailwind products are auto-rejected — check stack fit first
Paid-tier rejections get refunds, but free-tier rejections just don't list
Audience is Tailwind developers (140k visitors/6mo, 42.93% Tier-1)
countsAsLive: The product appears in Tailkits' templates/components/tools listings (paid tiers get a dedicated detail page and badges)
unknowns: Whether free-tier listings include a dofollow link (only paid 'Sponsored Post' explicitly promises dofollow)
Free-tier real review turnaround vs. the stated 14 days
